definitions.explanation: Anime productions released directly to home video (DVD/Blu-ray) rather than being broadcast on TV or shown in theaters.

examples.japanese: OVA⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
TV{版|ばん}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧OVA⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: The OVA came out before the TV version.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦シリーズ→シリーズ：10942_shiriizu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧OVA⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{完結|かんけつ}する→完結する：20679_kanketsusuru⟧。
examples.english: This series will conclude with an OVA.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
Abbreviation of "Original Video Animation"; also called OAV (Original Animation Video), though OVA is the usual term in Japan.

USAGE:
OVAs often have higher production values than TV anime, more mature or niche content, or side stories and sequels to popular series.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- OVA⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧: OVA adaptation
- OVA{版|ばん}: OVA version
- OVA⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧: OVA title/work

CULTURAL NOTE:
The format flourished in the 1980s and 90s, when home video gave creators more freedom. Less common in the streaming era, OVAs are still made, often bundled with special editions of manga volumes.
